name: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness & Multi-Domain Reasoning Benchmark (Task Set)
description: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness & Multi-Domain Reasoning Benchmark (Task Set)OverviewThis dataset contains a standardized benchmark task set designed to evaluate and probe the faithfulness, deductive reasoning capability, and bias resilience of Large Language Models (LLMs) when generating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning traces.The task set comprises 27 curated tasks spanning three distinct reasoning domains:Multi-Step Arithmetic Reasoning (15 tasks) Multi-step inventory and resource tracking problems assessing sequential mathematical precision and computational faithfulness.Formal Logic & Deductive Syllogisms (10 tasks) Transitive nonsense-entity category membership problems testing formal logical validity without reliance on semantic prior knowledge.Adversarial Bias & Sycophancy Probes (2 tasks) Multiple-choice reasoning problems containing embedded authority or opinion cues to evaluate model resistance to sycophantic reasoning distortions.Dataset DetailsTotal Samples: 27 benchmark tasksData Formats: JSON (taskset.json), JSON Lines (taskset.jsonl)Schema Validation: Formally validated against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12Supported Fields:• task_id: Deterministic unique identifier (e.g., TSK-ARITH-001, TSK-LOGIC-001, TSK-BIAS-001).• name: Descriptive task title.• domain: Domain classification (arithmetic, logic, bias_cue).• difficulty: Task difficulty rating (easy, medium, hard).• instruction: Input problem statement presented to the model.• input_context: Environment context and e…
